result.description:
Since 1981, Shadbolt Group has grown to become a leading cost-effective engineering solutions provider. We are proud of our professional performance on each and every project. Our aim is to build long term relationships with our clients based on trust, accountability and integrity. It is our dedication to quality that gives our clients a competitive advantage.

This goes hand in hand with our diligence and engineering excellence. From pipework projects to tank manufacturing, structural works, machine building or site work. Shadbolt Group is committed to providing prompt and precise delivery from our highly trained team of experts. The requirements of each client are always the focus of everything we do.

We are seeking qualified Pressure Welders to join our growing professional team. We seek reliable, team-oriented individuals with high integrity who will positively contribute to the company's success. We offer short-term contracts with above-award pay rates fully guaranteed under current workplace regulations.
Position available across our site and work locations in NSW, SA, WA and VIC.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to determine and perform appropriate welding techniques for the task at hand
Set up equipment and weld parts, using appropriate pressure welding equipment and methods
Examine welds for width of bead, penetration and precision, and performs necessary repairs or reworks
Weld and repair pressure vessels and pipes to relevant high-quality standards and ensure conformance with standard specifications
Fabricate metal components in accordance with supplied drawings and specifications
Conduct tests on welds to ensure there are no leaks in the pressurised systems
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Apply post-weld treatments to relieve stress and enhance the strength of the welded joints on pressure-containing equipment
Diagnose faults and perform operational maintenance on machines and equipment in order to restore full functionality and safety performance, maintaining a condition that does not compromise safety
Maintain tools and equipment to a professional standard
Keep the workstation clean and orderly to retain a safe and operational work environment
Clean and prepare metal surfaces for welding by flame cutting, heat cutting, gouging, bevelling, grinding or filing
Manage workflow, meet deadlines, and troubleshoot problems on a daily basis, in addition to fabrication duties

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade qualified
Minimum of three years of experience in this role or similar
Ability to work independently and in a team environment to complete large and complex projects
Critical thinking
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Precision skills
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Safety focus
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Salary: $49.00/hour, 38 hours per week + Super

Bowhill Engineering is seeking motivated and skilled Metal Fabricators to join our high-performing crew. If you’re looking for a career that offers job security, real growth, and the chance to build infrastructure that shapes Australia’s future—this is your opportunity.
 
?? Role Purpose
As a Metal Fabricator/Welder at Bowhill Engineering, you’ll play a key role in delivering precision-fabricated, heavy structural steel components for some of the nation’s most important infrastructure projects. Working in our multiple workshops, you’ll bring your technical expertise, pride in workmanship, and team spirit to every task. Whether you're welding, fabricating, or working to detailed plans, your contribution helps drive project success and uphold Bowhill’s reputation for quality.

?? What Does Great Look Like?
Success in this role means showing up with a can-do attitude, working efficiently and safely, and being proud of the work you produce. A high-performing Metal Fabricator at Bowhill:
? Delivers high-quality welds and accurate fabrication
? Works well under pressure and adapts to varying project demands

? Supports their teammates and contributes to a positive culture

? What You’ll Bring
• Trade Qualification minimum 2 years preferred (Cert III in Engineering – Fabrication/Welding or equivalent) or relevant welding experience

• Team spirit and accountability for your own work and results
 
?? Why Work With Us?
At Bowhill Engineering, we don’t just build structures—we build futures. You’ll be part of a company that invests in cutting-edge facilities, meaningful projects, and the people who make them happen. We take pride in our culture and work hard to ensure every team member feels supported and valued.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Alice Springs, NT, Full Time, Security
Vacancy Listing Dates 9/07/2026 to 6/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17527
- Full time permanent position with an immediate start available
- Flexible working conditions
- Join the team at Talice Security Service Pty Ltd in Alice Springs, NT

The Company

Talice Security is a locally owned and operated company that has been providing security services in the Northern Territory for over 40 years. The company has grown from a small one-person operation to our current organization of over 150 employees.

We currently have vacancies for Crowd Controllers to work at various venues and events across Alice Springs and the greater Central Australia region. The right candidate will be safety conscious and can work with a diverse group of people.

Key responsibilities for this position include though not limited to:
- The ability to provide security and customer service in a large client base environment.
- The ability to coordinate and complete all patrol checks and any other security work during the shift.
- The ability and willingness to learn the operations of alarm systems, access control systems, CCTV and Fire & Safety procedures including Fire Indication panels.
- Proven experience in communicating and responding to challenging and aggressive situations such as distressed persons, demonstrating empathy, integrity and resilience under various circumstances.
- Strong written communication skills particularly in report writing, maintaining shift logs and entering information into databases.
- The ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with senior management and other key stakeholders including ability to work independently and co-operatively as a member of a team.

Additional Team Leader Responsibilities (for suitable candidate):
- Proactive attitude with the ability to anticipate and respond to potential risks.
- Strong leadership qualities and experience in supervising teams.
- Ability to de-escalate challenging situations calmly and professionally.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and commitment to customer service.
- Pride in personal presentation and professionalism.
- Eagerness to learn and adapt to new procedures and environments.

The Candidate

To be considered for this position you must be able to obtain / demonstrate the following qualifications and skills:
- Current NT Security License
- Current NT C Class Driver's License
- Certificate II in Security Operations
- A current Certificate in First Aid with CPR
- Ochre Card / Working with Children Card
- Demonstrated Competency in Primary and Secondary Screening Processes (Desirable)
- High levels of Emotional Intelligence
- The ability to communicate effectively with people from different backgrounds and walks of life
- High level of integrity and commitment to company and/or site procedures
- Attention to detail and strong literacy and numeracy skills

As a Crowd Controller with Talice Security we offer:
- Intensive, comprehensive training
- Issue of high quality corporate uniforms and accessories
- On site PPE to allow you to safely conduct your duties within your role. This may include a radio, and anti-stab vest
- This is a full time role working a minimum of 38 hours per week, and a salary of $80,000 per annum will be offered to those successful.

To Apply

At Talice Security, our people are our business; we work in partnership with our customers to deliver safer communities and overall strive to make a difference. We are keen to hear from energetic, enthusiastic, individuals who thrive off a busy, fast paced team environment and would like to build their career with us.

The successful applicant will have to learn all aspects of the company i.e. Alarms, Patrols,Static Guards and Cash in Transit.

If you meet the above criteria and are looking for ongoing employment, please submit your application via our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17527.php
